findings.statement: The P0 segmented prompt fix prevents repeated authority-mapping traversal, but a reviewer child still receives an ambient repository execution context. It can expand tool reads beyond its assigned segment, so prompt byte gating alone cannot bound runtime context growth.

The parent retains raw child process material in the review-control path. Formal review state needs only validated structured candidate data and compact lifecycle projection; unbounded stdout, prompt material, and authority manifests must stay in attempt evidence and outside parent-facing status projection.
